title: Hot Today, Rain Tomorrow
text:
Today the weather is very hot. The sun is bright in the sky. There are no clouds, and it does not rain. People wear shorts and drink a lot of water.

Tomorrow the weather will be different. The sky will be grey and it will be cold. It may rain in the afternoon. Bring an umbrella and a warm coat.

questions.text: What is the weather like today?
What will the sky be like tomorrow?
Why do people probably wear shorts today?
What should you probably do tomorrow afternoon?

vocabulary.definition: full of light, strong and easy to see
white or grey shapes in the sky made of tiny drops of water
an object you hold above your head to stay dry when it rains
a colour between black and white

paragraph_translations: Hoje o tempo está muito quente. O sol está brilhante no céu. Não há nuvens e não chove. As pessoas usam bermudas e bebem muita água.
Amanhã o tempo será diferente. O céu ficará cinza e fará frio. Pode chover à tarde. Leve um guarda-chuva e um casaco quente.
